neighbours.label: the pronoun ' I' as the subject right after an introductory phrase or clause and a comma, mid-sentence ('For a book about art, ⟦I⟧ found…'); not sentence-initial 'I', not other pronouns in that slot
fire: As someone who grew up near the sea, I have always been wary of calm water.
Having read all four of her novels, I think the second is the weakest.
To put it as plainly as possible, I do not believe the figures in the report.
After weighing the evidence on both sides, I concluded that the trial was fair.
For a restaurant with such a reputation, I expected the service to be quicker.
Before getting into the details of the recipe, I should mention the oven.
Despite the long queue outside the gallery, I decided to wait for a ticket.
When the editor asked for a shorter version, I cut the whole third chapter.
